description: JST PH 2.0 mm wire-to-board header (B3B-PH-K-S), one signal contact + mated crimp terminal, lumped as C/2 - L - C/2.
justification: JST publishes no electrical model for PH. 5 nH / 0.5 pF is a typical order of magnitude for a ~10 mm pin + crimp at 2 mm pitch; the design's p027 sweep found the pixel-side edge insensitive to it (design sec. 12).
